legenda: what limits is your mind creating now?
abertura: This woman was blind for 15 years until one of her other personalities opened her eyes and started reading. In Germany, a woman known only as BT walked into therapy with Dr. Bruno Waldvogel.
transcricao: This woman was blind for 15 years until one of her other personalities opened her eyes and started reading. In Germany, a woman known only as BT walked into therapy with Dr. Bruno Waldvogel. She had more than 10 different personalities with different ages, different genders, different voices. Some only spoke German, some only spoke English. And she had been blind since an accident at 20 years old. Doctors said it was cortical blindness, damage to the visual part of her brain, and she would never see again. But four years into therapy, in the middle of a session, something happened. She was in her teenage boy personality, looked down at a magazine next to her and she just started reading it. The doctor froze, this woman hadn't seen anything in 15 years. So they tested her. And this is kind of insane because when she was in her blind personalities, her brain showed zero activity when they showed her something visual, nothing. But the second she switched off her personalities, her brain lit up like a normal person, she could see perfectly. Her blindness was never physical, it was psychological. Her mind shut off her vision to protect what she had been through, but not every Every personality needed that protection. And as therapy went on, 8 of her personalities got the vision back. The other 2 stayed blind holding the trauma that the rest couldn't carry. And she could go from being blind to seeing in seconds. Same eyes, same brain, just different personality. Think about that. If her mind could create blindness for 15 years and then remove it just like that, what has your mind created in your life that you swear is just permanent? What if some of the limits you think are real aren't real at all, but they're just protection that you actually don't need anymore? about that and welcome to the other side.

abertura: I took a pig, I gave it a bath, fed it, took it into my own house. And at the end of the day, it went back into the mud.
transcricao: I took a pig, I gave it a bath, fed it, took it into my own house. And at the end of the day, it went back into the mud. And that's what you do with people. You see someone living in a way that you don't like. And you decide you want to pull them out of there. You want to clean them up. You ask your partner not to talk to certain friends. You ask your friends to stop doing drugs. Or maybe you ask someone to stop cheating. And at the end, they don't understand you. I'm guilty of this. I asked someone to change for me and it worked for a while. But the pig doesn't go back into the mud because it's dirty. It goes back because you gave it a bath, but it never decided it wanted to be clean. The things that change by force just fall apart the moment you get distracted. Because you don't have to be the soap for somebody. The only thing that's yours to do is just not get in the mud with them. But still be there when he or she wants to come out. Welcome to the other side.

abertura: When you're angry, you don't have to say anything, nothing. And that's love of the other person and self-love too.
transcricao: When you're angry, you don't have to say anything, nothing. And that's love of the other person and self-love too. Because you know you're going to put yourself at risk, you know? And besides that, why? You know, like there's always a time later to say the things when you're calmer. But erasing what you said, you can't do that.

legenda: if you're afraid of being lonely
abertura: I was afraid of breaking up with my ex because I imagined that being alone was going to be unbearable. But after we broke up, I understood something.
transcricao: I was afraid of breaking up with my ex because I imagined that being alone was going to be unbearable. But after we broke up, I understood something. The fear that I had was because I was living a loneliness that was actually much worse than being alone. I was living a loneliness inside the relationship. And now I actually think that's the worst loneliness that there is. It's where your thoughts aren't heard, your will isn't respected, where the love you want to express isn't even appreciated. That's the worst loneliness that can exist. So don't be afraid to be alone. You might get less lonely. Welcome to the other side.

legenda: do you still think you're not enough?
abertura: I am not enough. I had a thought that I'm not enough.
transcricao: I am not enough. I had a thought that I'm not enough. I'm noticing a thought that I'm not enough. What evidence is there that I'm not enough? I am not this distortion that my thoughts are telling me that I am. I can let the thought that I'm not enough go.

abertura: What if I told you not everybody lives at the same level of consciousness? They say there are seven levels of consciousness and most people don't even make it past the first.
transcricao: What if I told you not everybody lives at the same level of consciousness? They say there are seven levels of consciousness and most people don't even make it past the first. Level one, you live within the system, you work, you consume, you repeat. You don't question anything, you just play the game, you're an autopilot. Level two, something starts to feel off. The news, your routine, all the noise, it just doesn't make sense to you but you still can't explain why. Level three, you start questioning everything. Politics, religion, even science. You start thinking for yourself and people start calling you crazy. Level 4. You start seeing the manipulation. You realize the system shapes your mind through music, movies, other people, and fear. Level 5. You stop blaming everything outside of yourself. You start looking inward and you realize that your emotions and patterns have been shaping your reality this whole time. Level 6. You become intentional. You start taking control of your energy and consciously shaping your life through what you focus on, what you believe in, and what you allow to say in your mind. Level 7. You become grateful for the experience. You understand that nothing outside of you is going to save you because you realize the power was inside of you all along. And if any of this somehow made sense to you, congratulations. Welcome to the other side.
